 ADVERTISEMENT REMOVE AD Old Video of a Tornado in Odisha Falsely Shared as Visuals of Cyclone Arnab
 The video dates back to March 2026 and shows a tornado that hit Odisha.
 Anika K Published :  29 Oct 2026, 1:33 PM IST WebQoof i A a A a Small A a Medium A a Large A video is being widely shared on social media, claiming to show visuals of Cyclone Arnab , which crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast on  28 October 2026 .
 (Archived versions of similar claims can be found here , here , and here .) 
 Is it true?: No, the claim is false. The video shows a tornado that struck Odisha’s Mayurbhanj district in March 2026.
 ADVERTISEMENT REMOVE AD How did we find out?: We ran a reverse image search on the video with Google Lens and found a Facebook post from March that shared the same visuals.
 The video , uploaded on 16 March 2026 , is captioned, "A powerful tornado struck villages near Karanjia in Odisha’s Mayurbhanj district on Sunday afternoon, killing two people and injuring at least 17 others, officials said." 
 We also found a post by the Instagram account of the Malayalam news publication Malayala Manorama from 16 March 2026 , with the same visuals.
 The caption states that the video shows a massive tornado that hit Mayurbhanj district, Odisha. 
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Manorama Online (@manoramaonline) 
 The Times of India has also published a report, sharing a compilation of clips from the tornado that caused havoc in Odisha’s Mayurbhanj district.
 The video contains the viral clip as well. 
 Conclusion: The video isn't related to Cyclone Arnab, and shows a tornado that struck Odisha’s Mayurbhanj district in March 2026 .
